lookFirst.description: Where to look first, as pointers and never a dump: the place the work starts as `file:line`, then the files the code is in with its own first and the shared ones after, the most widely shared first. Capped, with the count left out in `lookFirstNotShown`.

description: Everything a modernization needs to pick up one capability on its own: its layers with what it does and decides in each, its screens, the shared code it leans on, the data it uses, and what the analysis could not follow. Built only from the accepted records and the relation views, with no rendering decisions. Every place in it carries the context a tool that reads code starts from.
